```{r, echo = FALSE, results = "hide"}
nums <- sort(sample(1:1000, 2))
M <- mean(nums)
delta <- nums[2] - nums[1]
res <- nums[1]
```

Question
========

The mean of two numbers is `r M`, and one number is `r delta` more than the other. What is the value of the smaller of the two numbers?


Solution
========
We can solve this with some basic algebra where $x$ is the smaller of the two numbers:

$$
\begin{align}
\frac{x + (x + `r delta`)}{2} &= `r M` \\[0.5em]
\frac{2x + `r delta`}{2}      &= `r M` \\[0.5em]
2x + `r delta`                &= `r M` \times 2 \\[0.5em]
2x                            &= (`r M` \times 2) - `r delta` \\[0.5em]
x                             &= \frac{(`r M` \times 2) - `r delta`}{2} \\[0.5em]
x                             &= `r round(res, 5)`
\end{align}
$$
